subject: Exec presence for vendor briefing — short window on 4/20
messages:
From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@solsticeai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@solsticeai.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Briefing request — short exec window next Thursday

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this month. Our exec committee (CTO + VP Eng) has availability next Thursday, 4/20, for a short 30–40 minute briefing focused on integration lift and security posture. We know that availability is tight — headcount constraints mean they can only join at the start of the demo.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- 09:30–10:10
- 11:00–11:40

If neither works we can offer a single 20-minute slot at 16:00 but would prefer one of the morning windows. Attached is a quick agenda and a security question matrix.

Can you confirm who from Redwood should be present (CTO/CIO/VP-level)? Our execs want to meet the sponsor and have 10 minutes for Q&A.

Best,
Elena Costa
Head of Partnerships | SolsticeAI
Attachment: Solstice_Pilot_Agenda_v2.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@solsticeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Briefing request — short exec window next Thursday

Elena —

Thanks for the agenda and heads-up. We can cover integration and security in the time you suggested. Quick answers to your asks:

- Sponsor: Ben Carter (VP, Solutions) will lead the briefing and take the Q&A.
- Technical backup: Priyom Das (Principal SE) will be on the call for integration specifics.
- Exec presence: our CTO (Ilya Novak) is traveling and not available; our VP Product (Tessa Morgan — me) can join for the first 10 minutes to introduce the effort and cover product-level commitments.

Preferred slot: 09:30–10:10 PDT on 4/20. If you need the shorter 20-minute window, we can compress to 09:30–09:50 but Ben prefers the longer slot.

I've copied Ben and Priyom to confirm they can make 09:30. Also attaching a one-pager describing integration milestones.

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
VP Product | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Integration_1pager.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Costa <elena.costa@solsticeai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Briefing request — short exec window next Thursday

Tessa/Elena —

09:30–10:10 PDT works for me. I'll own the sponsor portion and make sure Priyom is queued up for the integration deep-dive.

Two small asks so the session is crisp:
1) Can Solstice share the specific integration touchpoints you want us to demonstrate (API mapping, auth, expected throughput) so we can prepare a 10-minute tech demo snippet?
2) Can the meeting invite call out "Sponsor briefing — exec attendees: CTO (Michael Reyes), VP Eng (Elena Costa)" so we know who to direct Q&A to?

If you want, I can block 09:00–10:30 as a buffer in case the call runs long.

—Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Costa <elena.costa@solsticeai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Reyes <michael.reyes@solsticeai.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Briefing request — short exec window next Thursday

Perfect — locking 09:30–10:10 PDT on 4/20. Calendar invite coming from me in a minute and I'll include the agenda attached earlier.

Answers:
- Integration touchpoints: auth (OIDC), data flow (S3 -> inference cluster), and tokenization latency under load. We'll highlight expected throughput and compliance guardrails.
- Invite title: "Sponsor briefing — exec attendees: CTO (Michael Reyes), VP Eng (Elena Costa)" — noted.

Attachments: Solstice_Security_Qs.xlsx (included), copy of the signed NDA (NDA_signed.pdf) — forwarding both in the invite.

See you Thu — Elena
